data.text: first time ko talaga maranasan yung baha na yun sa Manila🙃

Nagsagawa ng clearing operations ang Department of Sanitation and Cleanup Works of Quezon City (DSQC), katuwang ang Quezon City Department of Engineering (QCDE) noong Agosto 18, 2025 sa Barangay Bagong Silangan.

Ang aktibidad ay bahagi ng patuloy na tugon ng lokal na pamahalaan sa landslide na naganap dulot ng habagat noong Hulyo 25, 2025. 

Patuloy ang pagkilos at pagtutulungan ng iba-ibang ahensya ng lokal na pamahalaan upang ganap na maibalik ang kaayusan at kaligtasan sa komunidad.

Para sa mga concern at request sa clean-up o paghakot ng basura, maaaring makipag-ugnayan sa DSQC:

6th Floor, Building Regulatory Offices (Civic Center D), Mayaman St. Quezon City Hall Compound
Phone number: 8988-4242 loc. 8362
Email: DSQC@quezoncity.gov.ph
Facebook: https://t.co/mRof1opBCZ

data.text:
THE WAIT IS OVER! SINEKAB 2025 IS HERE!

The Film Development Council of the Philippines is proud to present the official selections for the 8th Sine Kabataan Film Festival! 10 promising young filmmakers from across the country are set to make their big screen debut from September 5-7, 2025 at Red Carpet Cinemas, Shangri-La Plaza!

Sine Kabataan Short Film Festival 2025 presents 10 original works from promising amateur filmmakers:

“4 Better or 4 Worse” Directed by RonJay Mendiola
“Blooming!” Directed by Ronnie Ramos
“City’s Laundry & Taxes” Directed by Diana Galang
“Coding si Papa” Directed by Michael Angelo Pogoy
“Due Date na ni Judith” Directed by Kieth Earl Rebaño
“Elephant Paths” Directed by Joshua de Vera
“Sa tumoy sa walay kahumanan [After the (G)rain is gone]” Directed by Von Jorge Actub
“SIGNAL PENDING” Directed by Lourchielle Hael
“Sunog sa Sugbo” Directed by Jon Owen Lepiten
“When it Rained Malunggay Leaves” Directed by Cedrick James Valenzuela

Stay tuned for screening schedules to witness the next generation of Filipino filmic excellence!

Check out our website for more details: https://t.co/NAvomauxhD

The Sine Kabataan Short Film Festival is an annual celebration of original short films, told through the eyes of young Filipino filmmakers. Now in its eighth edition, the festival returns this Philippine Film Industry Month (PFIM), organized by the Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP).

#FDCP #MovieOn #PhilippineCinema #SineKabataan2025 #PFIM2025
